title: The deploy smoke: the built candidate serves and answers healthy
description: The batch gate's smoke before any deploy: the candidate, built and served in the private trial container, answers GET /healthz?ready&strict with 200, healthy and ready, and with an owner recorded its merge commit is authored 'NAME (Mainworks) <EMAIL>' while the merge writer stays the committer. Every head a batched merge trial lands is on a candidate this smoke gates.
